case.name: Rio Grande Alameda to Albuquerque — 2023-05-12 event
case.purpose: One-time predeclared third-river structural transfer test; downstream observations are held out and no parameter will be adjusted after scoring.

selection_protocol.event_basis: The window brackets the 2023 spring high-flow period identified from USGS station metadata, before either event hydrograph was downloaded.
selection_protocol.first_run_policy: The first completed run and its score will be retained regardless of performance.
selection_protocol.calibration_policy: No Rio Grande observation may be used to select or adjust reach geometry, roughness, lateral inflow, initial conditions, or numerical settings.

sources.provider: U.S. Geological Survey Water Data APIs
U.S. Geological Survey Water Data APIs

reach.roughness_origin: Generic SI Manning n 0.035 divided by 60; fixed before observing the event
reach.width_source: Predeclared constant active-channel estimate; no event discharge was used
reach.length_source: USGS NLDI NHDPlusV2 routed centerline from USGS-08329918 to USGS-08330000
reach.slope_source: Difference between published NAVD88 gage datums divided by routed length
